mapper.sql: model_code AS modelCode, model_name AS modelName, model_version AS modelVersion, category, description, package_path AS packagePath, package_status AS packageStatus, public_visible AS publicVisible, runtime_ready AS runtimeReady, admin_note AS adminNote, seed_money AS seedMoney, expected_monthly_return_pct AS expectedMonthlyReturnPct, discovered_at AS discoveredAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quant_model_package_registry ORDER BY public_visible DESC, updated_at DESC, model_code ASC
SELECT FROM quant_model_package_registry WHERE public_visible = TRUE ORDER BY updated_at DESC, model_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_model_package_registry ( model_code, model_name, model_version, category, description, package_path, seed_money, expected_monthly_return_pct ) VALUES ( #{modelCode}, #{modelName}, #{modelVersion}, #{category}, #{description}, #{packagePath}, #{seedMoney}, #{expectedMonthlyReturnPct} ) ON CONFLICT (model_code) DO UPDATE SET model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, model_version = EXCLUDED.model_version, category = EXCLUDED.category, description = EXCLUDED.description, package_path = EXCLUDED.package_path, seed_money = EXCLUDED.seed_money, expected_monthly_return_pct = EXCLUDED.expected_monthly_return_pct, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_model_package_registry SET public_visible = #{publicVisible}, package_status = #{packageStatus}, admin_note = #{adminNote}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE model_code = #{modelCode}
